messages:
kate: heads-up: small hotpatch for quant path that fixes a mem spike in v2.15.1. rolling tonight during low-traffic window 03:00-04:00 UTC. image: runtime-kernel@v2.15.1-quant-zstd-hotfix. quick staging run passed for small prompts but we saw a 2% increase in transient retries on long prompts.

dan: can we do a very conservative progression? suggest 5% -> 25% -> 60% with 10m dwell. also enable conservative-batching on first two slices.

simon: agreed. add a quick probe to detect OOMs and sustained working set increase. if OOM count > 2 or mem_used_p90 increases >8% for 3 minutes we abort.

tia: will update release notes and publish a short rollback playbook. also add message to /customers impacted if we roll back.

deploy-bot: scheduled: runtime-kernel@v2.15.1-quant-zstd-hotfix canary 5% at 2024-11-06T03:00:00Z. cancel: `/deploy cancel 1748609999`. pin fallback: runtime-kernel@v2.15.0.

ops-bot: preflight: node drain capacity OK, telemetry hooks present (mem, oom_count, retry_rate). smoke tests: 4/4 passed except long-prompt tail-case. alerting: mem_p90 +8%, oom_count >=2, retry_rate +1%.

dan: add this quick telemetry check after ~3k requests: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://telemetry.internal/metrics?series=oom_count,mem_used_p90&window=5m` parse with jq.

simon: rollback steps (I will own): 1) `/deploy cancel 1748609999` 2) `/deploy pin runtime-kernel@v2.15.0 --global` 3) disable conservative-batching flag 4) open incident note if retries > 500 in 10m.

kate: for automation: can we set deploy-bot to auto-abort on mem_p90 +8% for >3m? deploy-bot supports threshold triggers, right?

deploy-bot: yes. automation configured: abort-if mem_used_p90_change_pct >= 8 for 3m OR oom_count >= 2 in 5m. Will notify @simon and #eng-oncall.

tia: i'll patch release notes: "hotfix: v2.15.1 quant zstd path addresses a memory growth regression on long sequences. conservative rollout and automatic aborts enabled." PR: https://redwood.internal/pulls/1212

ops-bot: alerts unmuted for 03:00-04:00 UTC. will stream a short summary every 10m to this thread and post quick telemetry snippets.

simon: ack - rollback owner and immediate pager if automation triggers.

dan: ack - monitoring. i'll flip conservative-batching flag after the 25% dwell if all good.

kate: ack - release owner for the window. i'll ping 20m before start and post final readiness check. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
